# O small_accessories_and_jewelry

Small non-core items that may be saved as accessory or rejected.

## O01 sunglasses white background seed

- Expected: accessory x1
- Difficulty: small_item, sunglasses, thin_frame
- Acceptance: Accessory detected; thin frame preserved.

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: closet cutout test image. Primary request: product catalog photo of black sunglasses on a pure white background, centered, full frame visible, no text, no watermark. Composition/framing: keep the relevant garment or object fully visible unless the case explicitly asks for crop. Lighting/mood: realistic natural or studio lighting. Constraints: avoid brand logos, readable text, watermarks, and unrelated extra garments unless requested.
```
